notablePrerequisites:
Clever Impersonator is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Clever Impersonator do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Clever Impersonator.
Activate Clever Impersonator by tapping it.
When Clever Impersonator becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Clever Impersonator's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
